verdict.rationale: The evidence covers downloadable open model weights (original Meta and Hugging Face formats) and running models across many platforms. Those are about the model artifacts, not exporting a user's own data, so they cannot be credited to this story. Nothing in the pack documents a user-data export feature, open export formats, or an account-exit path for Llama's hosted surfaces, such as the Meta AI chat or the llama.com tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
